summary.intent: Run load tests against the staging API with 10, 20, and 30 simultaneous clients to establish performance baselines.
summary.outcome: Three parallel load test workflow runs were triggered but failed due to misconfigured CI. Fixes for two bugs were committed to a new branch, but the tests were not successfully re-run within the session.

repo: Load test workflows live in .github/workflows/load-test.yml and tests/load/; the test runner is Vitest, not Jest.
Staging secrets/vars are scoped to a GitHub environment named 'staging' — jobs must declare `environment: staging` to access them.
Available load test scenarios: mixed-workload (default), upload-throughput, ipns-publish-storm, sustained-load, spike-test.
Staging API base URL is https://api-staging.cipherbox.cc.
Workflow run artifacts (metrics JSON) are retained for 30 days.

code.finding: Script was passing --testPathPattern (a Jest flag) to Vitest, which is invalid. Vitest uses positional arguments for file filtering.
Job was missing `environment: staging` declaration, causing all staging env vars and secrets to be empty at runtime.

workflow: gh workflow run can be used to trigger parallel CI runs with different input parameters simultaneously.
gh run list / gh run view are useful for quickly checking run status and fetching failure logs without opening the browser.

friction: Initial load test runs all failed silently — the root causes (wrong test flag, missing environment declaration) were not caught until logs were inspected post-failure.
User had to interrupt and re-state the request to add the staging target, suggesting the original prompt was ambiguous about environment.
The CI workflow had two independent bugs that together caused total failure, requiring fixes to both package.json and the workflow file before any useful test results could be obtained.
open_items: Re-trigger the 10/20/30 client load tests after the fix branch is merged to confirm the workflow runs successfully.
Decide whether to also run non-default scenarios (upload-throughput, ipns-publish-storm, sustained-load, spike-test) for a more complete baseline.
Monitor completed runs and review the metrics JSON artifacts once tests pass.
Consider whether the fix branch needs a PR review before merging, or can be fast-tracked given it's a CI-only fix.
